fields.description: Eaton Square brings full-floor office ownership to Meydan Horizon in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Ellington markets the offices as Grade A shell-and-core space, allowing occupiers to plan their own interiors. Double-level offices offer another option alongside the typical single-floor layouts.
